notes.content: This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s). Critical Thinking (1B) is waived. Take only one course in either Arts (3A) or Humanities (3B). The other is waived. MECH 340W (upper division: taken after transfer) is an approved major course substitution for Social and Behavioral Sciences (4).
notes.contentHtml:
This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s).

  • Critical Thinking (1B) is waived.
  • Take only one course in either Arts (3A) or Humanities (3B). The other is waived.
  • MECH 340W (upper division: taken after transfer) is an approved major course substitution for Social and Behavioral Sciences (4).
